install_backend.description: Install laya-mlx into the managed Python environment.

installed_backend.description: Run the resident Laya judgment worker over NDJSON stdio.

tools.notes: Local typed decision model (choice/score/noul) for the judgment-backend seam. Encoder, not generative: no token decoding, deterministic across runs, ~24ms per judgment on Apple Silicon. Runs entirely on-device, so it is the local-only judgment provider and may see personal and confidential material. First load downloads the checkpoint from Hugging Face.
